title: Tilt table test
what: You lie on a special table with safety straps. The table is tilted almost upright, and the doctor watches your blood pressure and pulse.
why: For repeated fainting or near-fainting, to find the cause.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes, sometimes up to 90; the report is usually ready the same day
tell_doctor: What your fainting is like: when, how often, and what comes before it
All medicines, especially for blood pressure and the heart

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food for 2 to 4 hours before the test. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Some medicines are sometimes skipped. Do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor in advance.

prepare.title: Someone with you
prepare.text: Better to come with someone. You may feel weak after the test.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, with no tight belt.

bring: Past ECGs, Holter results, and echocardiograms
steps: You lie on the table and are secured with straps
ECG stickers and a blood pressure cuff are put on, sometimes an IV line too
First, you lie quietly for a few minutes
The table is slowly tilted almost upright
You stand still on the table while the doctor watches your blood pressure and pulse
Sometimes a medicine is given under the tongue and you are watched longer
If you feel unwell, the table is lowered right away
feel: You may feel weak, sick, or sweaty, like before fainting. Tell the doctor
Sometimes people faint. This is expected. The table is lowered, and you come round quickly
after: Lie down and rest until you feel better
Better not to drive on the test day
The report is usually ready the same day
red_flags: Chest pain, strong irregular heartbeats, or repeated fainting at home: call emergency services

faq.a: You are strapped in, and the table is lowered right away. You usually come round in seconds, and the doctor is right there.

faq.q: Why bring on a faint on purpose?
faq.a: To see what happens to your blood pressure and pulse at that moment. This makes the cause easier to find.

reminders.text: Tilt table test tomorrow. Do not eat for the time the clinic told you. Come with someone.
